name: Richard Fiore
reviewNotes:
No personal website found. He also writes the newsletter's technique column.

Directory research 2026-10-04: No personal website or social page found; the website field is Adelphi's course page, which is the only official page naming him (it is also the adelphi-university organizer's website). His own listing in The Dance Calendar's Find an Instructor directory gives a lesson phone and a Yahoo email; not recorded because the brief limits teacher contacts to their own website or business page - owner may choose to add them. No photo of him was found on Adelphi's site.
description: Richard Fiore teaches the Friday evening social and ballroom dance course at Adelphi University in Garden City, covering dances such as foxtrot, waltz, rumba, cha-cha, tango, swing and hustle. He is licensed by the Imperial Society of Teachers of Dancing and writes a dance technique column for The Dance Calendar.

evidence.note: Adelphi's Social and Ballroom Dancing course page names Richard Fiore (Dual Licentiate, Imperial Society of Teachers of Dancing) as instructor; fall 2026 classes run Fridays 7-8:30 PM in Woodruff Hall, Room 304.
Adelphi news post shows he has taught the same non-credit ballroom course since at least 2018.
The Dance Calendar's articles page describes Richard Fiore as a professional dance educator and trainer who writes its technique articles.
He has an instructor listing (ISTD Licentiate in Latin, ballroom and tango) offering syllabus-based ballroom lessons, with a phone and Yahoo email.
